title: Український правопис як стандарт набрав чинності
usedFor: Legal status of the orthography: the standard was approved by decision No. 47 of 1 March 2026 and came into force on 28 March 2026, after Resolution No. 398 of 27 March 2026 revoked Resolution No. 437 of 22 May 2019. The spelling rules did not change from 2019.
notes: Government news item dated 31 March 2026, not the legal text itself. An LB.ua report of the same date says the same.
